messages:
Maria: Quick check — customer pilot (Acme) wants 99.9% p95 latency SLA for chat flows. We need a preflight to sign off on infra/runtime/security. Who can own?

Sam: I can take eng scope for runtime integration. Need capacity numbers and evictions. @Alex, can you outline KV cache expectations?

Alex: KV cache will need warm-up. With our current pooling, expect cold-start p95 ~450ms for long contexts. With prefix cache enabled and pre-warm -> ~160ms. We should add a short warmup window.

Jing: Infra: can provision burst nodes but there's a quota change request to cloud. ETA 3 biz days to approve. We might need fallback routing to smaller models.

Luke: Security: data residency + audit logs are required. For pilot, we can accept logs at 30d retention. Also need key rotation plan.

Maria: Ok action items: Sam -> runtime preflight checklist + SLA test; Alex -> warmup script and expected numbers; Jing -> quota request + fallback circuit; Luke -> data retention + HSM plan. Can we get these by EOD Friday?

Sam: EOD Friday is tight; can aim for Friday noon-ish for checklist draft. I'll include test harness commands:

```bash
# run p95 harness
python tests/loadtest.py --model rdm-chat-medium --concurrency 4 --duration 600
```

Alex: I'll attach a simple warmup snippet:

```python
for prompt in warm_prompts:
    client.generate(prompt, max_tokens=8)
```

Jing: Started quota ticket 12345, added tentative autoscale policy. If approval delayed, plan B is model routing to rdm-chat-small with degrade notice.

Luke: Also propose gating on a canary window (1h, 10% traffic) and auto-roll-back on p95 > 700ms or error rate > 1%.

Maria: Sounds good. @Sam please add clear rollback triggers and metrics to the checklist. Also, what's the expected token cost estimate? Need to tell Sales.

Sam: Guessing ~0.5 tokens/msg avg -> will run cost calc after harness. Putting item in checklist.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary for pilot-acme at 2026-04-02T18:00Z (manual approve required)

Maria: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers ping me. We'll sync again Friday 11:30 to review checklist. :thumbsup:

Jing: If quota delayed beyond Friday, bump canary by one week and notify CS.
